reason: I would download the free version and try it, but I would not pay. The whole point is receipt scanning, and Arabic receipts are usually messy, mixed with English and printed badly, so I do not believe it reads them properly. My helper does part of the cooking and I already manage the list with her on WhatsApp for free.
objection: Receipt scanning never reads Arabic receipts properly, and I hate paying a subscription for something the free version and WhatsApp already do well enough.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it correctly read a real, crumpled Gulf supermarket receipt in Arabic during the free trial, and a price near $10 a year or a one-time payment instead of a subscription.
